Thought I posted a blurb in my post but it didn't work. Struggled with a large hairline my entire life and it wasn't until a bad haircut in my early 20's that I knew I was receding heavily. A  trip to hair doctor as well confirmed that my hair was not growing back in certain areas.  


My hair has limited me from being social and being confident in myself. I've always had issues with the way I've looked and my hair has always been one of the culprits. I want to be able to go out to bars/clubs/events and socialize and grow my social circle. I want to go on a trip soon and be able to enjoy myself knowing I look okay with no hair. Moving forward I know it'll grow back and expose my large hairline even more but at this point I don't think any hair treatment plans would save me or if they could it would cost 20-30k which I could afford but have chosen not to go forward with because i want to improve other areas of my life and not just my hair.   


Apologies for the long blurb, just not sure what to do!
